about_the_game:
Aetherion is an atmospheric 2D action-adventure game with Metroidvania elements. Explore a mysterious world, face challenging boss battles, and discover how your character and the environment change over the course of your journey.

Features

Atmospheric Metroidvania world: Explore the mystical world of Aetherion, as well as deeply hidden caves and ruins. Each area holds secrets, new enemies and unique mechanics.

Challenging boss battles: Face powerful creatures that will test your skills with different attack patterns and phases.

Crafting & resources: Collect materials and essences to create equipment, upgrades or new possibilities.

Sandbox building: Build and design your own structures - as an additional gameplay option alongside the main progression.

Exploration & secrets: Find hidden locations, discover shortcuts and uncover the secrets of the world of Aetherion.
